title: Director of Product
summary: A director of product leads a product line and the product managers who run it, usually reporting to a VP Product or CPO. They set the product vision and roadmap, set goals and track results, make the business case for investment, plan launches with marketing and sales, and hire and coach product managers.
dailyDuties: Review roadmap progress and product metrics
Coach product managers on discovery and priorities
Agree quarterly plans with engineering and business leaders
Write the business case for new bets
Plan launches with marketing and sales

skills.expectation: Own the roadmap for a product line
Make sure teams learn from customers before building
Set product goals and track outcomes
Plan launches with marketing and sales
Lead product managers and group PMs
Agree plans with engineering, design and business
Shape build versus buy and platform choices with engineering
Fintech domain knowledge for BFSI products
